day_shape: 90 items: Israeli troops crossed the Litani with multiple IDF evacuation orders in south Lebanon, Trump's Iran-deal Situation Room meeting ended without decision, State Dept sanctioned an Iranian fraud-procurement network, and regime channels signalled a 'grand' funeral for slain Khamenei.

threads.label: IDF crosses Litani, strikes south Lebanon
threads.summary: Netanyahu confirmed 36th Division troops crossed the Litani River and advanced to dominating terrain, with IDF Arabic spokesperson Adraee issuing evacuation warnings for Jdeideh Ansar, Mifdoun, Zafta and other villages. The IDF published footage it said showed Hezbollah rockets striking Saint Georges Orthodox Church in Marjaayoun; Israeli and Lebanese military officials met at the Pentagon.

threads.label: Trump Iran-deal decision and US posture
threads.summary: Trump went to the Situation Room for a 'final determination' on Iran but the meeting ended without a decision; Defense Secretary Hegseth said the US is ready to restart attacks if no deal is reached. CENTCOM said 115 commercial vessels have been redirected under the Iran blockade as of May 29, with Pakistani FM Dar arriving in Washington for talks with Rubio.

threads.label: US sanctions and alleged Iran plots abroad
threads.summary: The State Department announced sanctions on an Iranian-affiliated fraud network accused of impersonating US firms to obtain technology for Iran's military, framed as part of 'Economic Fury'. UK police charged a Greek national with assisting Iranian intelligence in targeting an Iran International journalist, and a New York case was reported involving an alleged Iran-linked campaign against Diaspora Jews.

threads.label: UAE reported strikes on Iran
threads.summary: Times of Israel and Jerusalem Post cited a Wall Street Journal report that the UAE struck Iranian energy infrastructure dozens of times during the war and amid the truce, using US and Israeli intelligence after Iranian attacks on UAE infrastructure. Defa Press separately claimed Tanker Trackers data showed a supertanker loading two million barrels of Iranian crude.

threads.label: Regime messaging on succession and war
threads.summary: Times of Israel reported Iranian state TV said Tehran is preparing a 'grand' funeral for slain leader Ali Khamenei, while Khamenei's office Telegram posted messages attributed to Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei urging cohesion and warning against turning disagreements into division. The office also published photos from a second-day memorial for 'martyrs of the household of the martyred Imam'.

threads.label: Regime claims on war damage and exports
threads.summary: IRIB cited Bloomberg to claim five Americans were injured and an MQ-9 Reaper destroyed at Ali Al-Salem base in Kuwait from Iranian missile debris, and reported the Israeli health ministry put cumulative injured at 8,909. Defa Press hailed IRGC fast-attack boats during the '40-day third imposed war' and IRIB quoted parliament speaker Qalibaf saying concessions come 'through missiles, not dialogue'.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz closure framing
threads.summary: IRIB amplified a New York Post item claiming the Strait of Hormuz remains closed and jet-fuel shortages in Europe are driving up transatlantic ticket prices, with a six-to-eight week supply lag even if a deal is reached. A separate IRIB commentary argued the strait 'is not an international waterway' and pertains only to Iran and Oman, rejecting Trump's demand it be opened without payment.

events.summary: The designation of Lebanon for Temporary Protected Status (TPS), which was set to expire on May 27, 2026, is automatically extended to November 27, 2026. Under the TPS statute, if the Secretary does not determine whether a foreign state continues to meet the conditions for designation for TPS at least 60 days before the expiration of the country's current TPS designation, the period of designation is automatically extended for six months. Rapidly unfolding events in Lebanon in March 2026 impacted the Department's ability to conduct a thorough review of prevailing country conditions for the Secretary's timely consideration and determination.
